questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Personal connection to the destination (heritage / friends there/ etc.)

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Milano er en let tilgængelig by, hvorfor det er let at komme til og fra København - både ift. at få besøg, men også sikkerheden i hurtigt at kunne komme hjem, hvis det skulle være nødvendigt. Derudover er Italien et skønt land at rejse rundt i. Jeg ser det også som en klar fordel, at KU har så mange pladser i Milano, så der er mulighed for at tage afsted med ens venner fra studiet.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Massimo har været universitets kontaktpeson, og han har været let tilgængelig. Når det er sagt, så skal man være meget proaktiv for at få information generelt.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Vi fik underskrevet vores "proof of attendance" en af de første dage - dette var der skiltet til.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Vi havde fået anbefalet et udlejningsselskab af nogle tidligere udvekslingsstuderende - Novecento case - kan kun anbefale dem.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Metrosystemet er en smule utilregneligt, og der er en del strejke på random tidspunktet - det er derfor en stor fordel at bå i gåafstand til campus.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg kender ikke til mulighederne for housing, som universitetet har stilt til rådighed.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Man kunne bare møde op til undervisningen på adskillige fag, og først efter et par gange skulle man registerer sig permanent. Nogle undervisere ville bare have en mail, andre ville have en papir sedel med navn, mens andre ønskede en formel registerering på hjemmesiden. Dette fandt man kun ud af ved at spørge den enkelte.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Vi fik en guide til den formelle registererings proces, men underviserene ønskede det på hver deres måde alligevel.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Mit indtryk var, at der var plads nok på alle hold. Meget af undervisningen på de mere nice fag lå dog oveni hinanden eller på tidpsunkter som 16-18 om fredagen, hvorfor man følte sig nødsaget til at vælge nogle mindre attraktive fag.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Prioriter et godt skema, hvor der ikke er "huller" i undervisningen.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Sværhedsgraden er meget lav, og det er ikke så meget jura man bliver vurderet på. Fx i food law kom vi til eksamen i insektarter - det står ingen steder i direktivet haha

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Det er udelukkende klasseundervisning.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
INTERNATIONAL CRIMINAL LAW
INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS AND SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT 
LABOUR LAW AND ENVIRONMENTAL SUSTAINABILITY
SCIENTIFIC INNOVATION AND LEGAL CHALLENGES OF FOOD REGULATION
COMPARATIVE CONTRACT LAW

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg kan anbefale criminal law og comparative contrakt law. Jeg kan ikke anbefale Inter org. og food law.

Additional comments:
questions.answer: Disse har jeg ikke udforsket.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Tror man kunne tage et sprog kursus i italiensk.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Rejs Italien rundt!

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Como, Porto fino, Firenze mv.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Italienerne er søde og gode mennesker, men de kan også være ret rude, når de ikke forstår hvad du siger.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Det gjorde jeg ikke.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Bestille is-kaffe - det forstod de ikke hvad var.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Aperol til EUR 5.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
- Spar nok penge op
- Lav et godt skoleskema, så I har meget fritid til at rejse rundt og gøre hvad I vil.
- Køb et travel card til byen og sørg for at bo centralt.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Du skal ikke tage herhen for det akademiske niveau.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: At opleve med mine venner - toget kan klart anbefales.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: at kommunikere med Italierne, og forstå vores underviseres accent.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
